event_types.description: The event types to receive, by name from the AsyncAPI catalogue (contracts/events); no wildcard. Security, personal-data and payee events are never sent.

items.description: An event type, fyniq.<object>.<event>.v<N>, from the deliverable list of the AsyncAPI catalogue.

url.description: An https address on a public host; Fyniq never sends to a private, loopback or link-local address, never follows a redirect, and refuses an address with credentials in it.
